fields.name: currunix
fields.doc: When the event happened: the settled instant, UTC.

fields.name: creaunix
fields.doc: When the event was created, where that is known; the earliest its chain knows once followed.

fields.name: execunix
fields.doc: The latest execution clock this lifecycle reached as of this event; an execution dates itself, following carries it, and duplicate statements keep their earliest observation.

fields.name: recdunix

fields.name: refrecdunix

fields.name: exprtime
fields.doc: When the event stops being good, where it does; the latest its chain knows once followed.

fields.name: prevunix
fields.doc: When the event this one follows happened, where it follows one.

fields.name: snapunix
fields.doc: The grid instant a walk read this event as the snapshot of; empty on every row no snapshot was taken of.

fields.name: curruuid
fields.doc: The event's identity: UUIDv7 ordered by millisecond and sequence, with a content payload seeded by its cross hash.

fields.name: crossuuid
fields.doc: The identity every event of one chain shares, derived from the code they share; the event's own where it names none.

fields.name: crosscode
fields.doc: The code every event of one chain shares, as the event spells it; empty where none.
